# Linux Foundation project Gerrit servers egress allow-list.
#
# This list deliberately holds the project Gerrit servers and nothing
# else. It serves jobs whose only traffic beyond GitHub's own
# endpoints is a project Gerrit: clearing and setting a vote, or
# asking whether a change is readable, with 'gerrit query' and
# 'gerrit review' over SSH. Such a job can load this short list in
# 'block' mode instead of the organisation list. Do not add other
# hosts here; they belong in the organisation list.
#
# Load it by explicit path with harden-runner-block-action:
#
#   - uses: lfreleng-actions/harden-runner-block-action@<sha>  # <version>
#     with:
#       config: 'lfreleng-actions//.github/harden-runner/lf-gerrit-servers/gerrit_servers.txt@<.github commit sha>'
#
# To combine it with the organisation list, set config: '@<sha>' and
# supplemental_config: 'lfreleng-actions//.github/harden-runner/lf-gerrit-servers/gerrit_servers.txt@<sha>'.
#
# This file is not named 'allow_list.txt' on purpose. When a fork's
# config: '@<sha>' misses both the org-specific and the family-default
# path, harden-runner-block-action falls back to the one directory
# under .github/harden-runner/ that holds a file with the requested
# name. A second 'allow_list.txt' would make that match ambiguous and
# break the fallback for every fork. A file with another name is
# invisible to the search, and an explicit path never falls back.
#
# Every entry here is also present, on purpose, in the organisation
# list (../lfreleng-actions/allow_list.txt), so a workflow can move
# from one list to the other without both changing in lockstep;
# harden-runner-block-action de-duplicates a supplemental list against
# its baseline.
#
# Format: one host[:port] entry per line, sorted alphabetically
# (LC_ALL=C), no wildcards, with a '# comment' directly above each
# host. Each server is listed on both ports: 29418 for SSH
# ('gerrit query', 'gerrit review', git over SSH) and 443 for HTTPS
# (clone, REST).

# Gerrit (Automotive Grade Linux): SSH queries, review voting and
# git over SSH (29418); clone and REST (443).
gerrit.automotivelinux.org:29418
gerrit.automotivelinux.org:443

# Gerrit (FD.io): SSH queries, review voting and git over SSH
# (29418); clone and REST (443).
gerrit.fd.io:29418
gerrit.fd.io:443

# Gerrit (LF Broadband): SSH queries, review voting and git over SSH
# (29418); clone and REST (443).
gerrit.lfbroadband.org:29418
gerrit.lfbroadband.org:443

# Gerrit (LF Releng): SSH queries, review voting and git over SSH
# (29418); clone and REST (443).
gerrit.linuxfoundation.org:29418
gerrit.linuxfoundation.org:443

# Gerrit (O-RAN-SC): SSH queries, review voting and git over SSH
# (29418); clone and REST (443).
gerrit.o-ran-sc.org:29418
gerrit.o-ran-sc.org:443

# Gerrit (ONAP): SSH queries, review voting and git over SSH (29418);
# clone and REST (443).
gerrit.onap.org:29418
gerrit.onap.org:443

# Gerrit (Anuket, formerly OPNFV): SSH queries, review voting and git
# over SSH (29418); clone and REST (443).
gerrit.opnfv.org:29418
gerrit.opnfv.org:443

# Gerrit (OpenDaylight): its SSH host; the web UI sits under
# /gerrit. SSH queries, review voting and git over SSH (29418); clone
# and REST (443).
git.opendaylight.org:29418
git.opendaylight.org:443
